description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN a cited HMRC internal-manual page must be read.

Returns bounded source-order text, canonical URL, manual reference,
source metadata, and retrieval provenance. AFTER calling, cite or analyse
only returned text; if retrieval fails, do not infer the page's contents.
Source: the allowlisted official GOV.UK HMRC internal-manual page.

manual_family.description: GOV.UK manual-family slug, e.g. 'employment-income-manual'. Required with reference when manual_url is omitted.

manual_url.description: Canonical HTTPS GOV.UK HMRC internal-manual page URL. Provide this OR manual_family plus reference.

max_chars.description: Maximum main-text characters to return (500–20000). Truncation is explicitly reported.

reference.description: Manual page reference, e.g. 'EIM00500'. Required with manual_family when manual_url is omitted.

name: hmrc_get_manual_page

outputSchema.description: Bounded content retrieved from one canonical HMRC internal-manual page.

breadcrumbs.description: Source-supplied GOV.UK breadcrumb labels, in display order

canonical_url.description: Final allowlisted GOV.UK URL retrieved for this manual page

content.description: Source-order main page text, bounded by max_chars; never an LLM summary

content_truncated.description: True when content was cut to max_chars

original_length.description: Main-text character length before any truncation

reference.description: Manual page reference from the canonical GOV.UK path, e.g. eim00500

retrieved_at.description: UTC timestamp when this official GOV.UK page was retrieved

updated.description: Source page update date where GOV.UK supplied one

title: Read HMRC Internal Manual Page
